{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Ox''' (己丑, ''tsuchinoto ushi''; onyomi ''kichū'') is the 26th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 26th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Rat|ja|戊子|1=Yang Earth Rat}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Tiger|ja|庚寅|1=Yang Metal Tiger}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''丑'' (Ox) is Yin Earth; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Ox (己丑)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐchǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 cau2
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Tsuchinoto-ushi
***Kunyomi 2: Kido-no-ushi
***Onyomi 1: kichū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gichuk (기축)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Sửu

==Months of Yin Earth Ox==
In years ending in 0 or 5 (when the Heavenly Stem is {{ill|Geng (庚)|ja|庚|1=Kanoe (庚)|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Geng (庚)}} or {{ill|Yi (乙)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (乙)}}), the twelfth lunar month is a Jichou month. This is determined based on the [[:en:Chinese lunisolar calendar|Chinese lunisolar calendar]], meaning it may also be calculated using the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} system (from [[:en:Lesser Cold|Lesser Cold]] to the day before [[:en:Beginning of Spring|Beginning of Spring]]).

==Days of Yin Earth Ox==
A Jichou day follows a 60-day cycle.

=== Special Characteristics ===
Jichou days are the 6th day in the [[Ten Days of Mourning|Ten Days of Mourning]] (十方暮).
